## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and their results. Call out checks that were not run.

## Permissions, data, and dependencies

Describe any changes to browser permissions, external requests, storage formats, or dependencies. Write "None" when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The scope is focused and documentation matches the change.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, and unverified behavior is stated.
- [ ] Examples, screenshots, and logs contain no private data or secrets.
- [ ] UI changes include keyboard and accessibility verification, when applicable.
